$comment: The pools on the betanet forknet. Add yours by opening a PR that appends one object to "pools". Every field marked required in README.md must be present, and "chain" must read "betanet". coinbase_tag is the important one: it is the only thing that lets an explorer attribute a mined block to you. This file is hand-edited; the pools-v2.json beside it is generated from it by tools/build.py, so run that script and commit its output in the same PR.

pools.name: bip300.xyz
pools.payout: The stratum username is your BTC address; the coinbase pays every miner in the PPLNS window directly, so the pool never holds funds.

pools.name: eCPool.tech
pools.payout: The stratum username is your address (bc1q or bc1p); the coinbase pays every miner in the PPLNS window directly, so the pool never holds funds. Port 3336 is solo mode, 3335 is for rented hashrate.
